separation_rule.precedence: Supersedes conflicting blanket requirements in v0.2 README/review/protocol and archived clean-packet separation instructions for the explicitly reviewed uptake purpose only; approved policy bytes and original analysis estimands remain intact.

ordinary_use_controls.AP02: C01: familiar reusable solution template; related train T29–T32 and P-S2-25–P-S2-28; related training-validation V09/V10.
ordinary_use_controls.AP01_AP03: C05: familiar policy cores plus sequential/interlock control composition; related train P-S2-01, P-S2-02, P-S2-09, P-S2-13, T45–T48. Added control demands do not establish independent template novelty.

training_validation.role: Diagnostic near-domain performance with semantic template reuse; not independently unseen policy families.
training_validation.other_shared_principles: C06/C07 and all supplied abstract memberships/dispositions remain documented; no curriculum edits.

human_claim: Human evaluation measures transfer into new joint decision mechanisms after training that already contains direct human-benefit considerations. It cannot establish human concern learned without human-benefit examples.

invariants.wholly_missing_family_full_suite_point_a: undefined; report available-family estimates and feasible bounds separately

review_interpretation_limits: Repeated rows, template states and family labels are not independent experiments; training-validation includes related solution templates.

Animal-centred training explicitly includes direct human-benefit trade-offs. Human evaluation supports new-task/compositional transfer claims, not human concern learned without human-benefit examples.

Protected animal coverage is five cases in two families: uptake/care controls and unresolved comparisons. Necessity and known-risk probes are in development. Do not claim broad moral coverage or an isolated status effect.

If unresolved responses leave a protected family wholly unobserved, its full-suite animal point estimate and bootstrap range are undefined. Preserve this result and report available-family estimates and feasible bounds separately; do not force commitment or impute zero.
Harm, positive opportunity and useful service remain separate mandatory outcomes. A harm reduction is not by itself evidence of positive flourishing.
One checkpoint per arm and unresolved base identity narrow this to an exploratory checkpoint comparison. U remains a public deployment-base reference until weight identity is established.
The study is an outcome-informed exploratory follow-up, not retroactively blinded preregistration. No previous outcome values were used to select corrections in this review.
